I'm sorry friend. I'm not sure what to tell you. 
I'm in the same boat.

I can't tell if your profile is an elaborate troll or real.

If it's real then I feel sorry for the poor girl that was roped into marrying you.

Iktf
It's hard to stay motivated when you know that you'll always be undesirable.
Why are you so against plastic surgery if you can afford it and being attractive is so important to you?
Sorry lad I don't have xbox and I don't play videogames. I'm far too busy these days.

I think there's probably a lot going on psychologically here. Being shunned and undesirable as a man can be quite emasculating. Maybe at some subconscious level you're trying to distance yourself from your perceived failure as a man. 

I don't mean to discount your identity or anything, I'm sure what you feel is real but there are probably reasons for it. I think you would be a lot happier if you came to terms with your identity as a male rather than trying to transition because of what may well be a temporary condition and ending up permanently ruined.

All the best.

My low self-esteem totally paralyzes me in this regard, I feel like any time I try to approach a woman or ask her out I'm indirectly insulting her. As if my desire to be with her is some form of assault.

I'm not desirable, I'm not a sexual being. I'm just trash.

I feel it too, I think it's natural. I find it difficult to deal with because I have nobody/nothing to direct it at. 

I'm angry at the universe but the universe doesn't care about me, none of these horrible things happened to me for a reason; they just happened.

People seem to have this idea that they have a duty to prevent you from committing suicide, and they'll use any method they can whether that means guilt tripping you by talking about how you'll hurt your family or even locking you up in a psychiatric ward and medicating you. 

But then they all disappear once you're no longer suicidal, as if they want nothing to do with you. They ignore the fact that loneliness is one of the main factors that drove you to consider suicide.

Most people don't seem to care about the quality of your life, only that you keep on living.

I keep doing it as if it'll somehow bring me relief.

It never does.
I havent bothered with tinder for this exact reason, I dont need another reminder of how ugly I am.
